command:
sh -c uname -m &&
            uname -n &&
            uname -p &&
            uname -r &&
            uname -s &&
            uname -v
awk -F: BEGIN{ret=1} /^gpg-agent:/{if ($5 == "1") { ret=0; exit 0 } } END {exit ret}
bash -c apt update && apt install -y healthcheckd
dpkg-deb -f /var/cache/apt/archives/healthcheckd_1.0-2_amd64.deb Package Source Version Architecture Status
